zh: 索尔福德大学（University of Salford） 是一所位于英国大曼彻斯特索尔福德的公立研究型大学. 主校区距离曼彻斯特市中心以西约1.5 mi，处于艾尔维尔河沿岸. 校门对面是工人阶级运动图书馆.
该大学的历史可追溯到1896Royal Technical Institute, Salford的成立，此教育机构是由1858年成立的Salford Working Men's College和1850年成立的力学研究所合并而成.

1921年更名索尔福德皇家科技学院（Royal Technical College, Salford）. 1958年分裂，Peel Park Technical College开始独立办学. 后者1961年改名Salford Technical Institute，1970年成为索尔福德科技学院（Salford College of Technology），1992年成为索尔福德大学学院（University College Salford）.
1956年，索尔福德皇家科技学院更名为先进技术学院（College of Advanced Technology），1967年获大学资格，改名为索尔福德大学. 1996年索尔福德大学学院又重新并入索尔福德大学.
索尔福德大学总共设有四座校区，校区之间有免费接驳公车. 最近机场为曼彻斯特国际机场.
en: The University of Salford is a public research university located in Salford, Greater Manchester, England, 1 mi west of Manchester city centre. The Royal Technical Institute, Salford, which opened in 1896, became a College of Advanced Technology in 1956 and gained university status in 1967, following the Robbins Report into higher education.
It has students and is in 160 acre of parkland on the banks of the River Irwell.

The university's origins can be traced to the opening in 1896 of the Royal Technical Institute, Salford, a merger of Salford Working Men's College (founded in 1858) and Pendleton Mechanics' Institute (founded in 1850). The Royal Technical Institute received royal letters after the then-Duke and Duchess of York (later King George V and Queen Mary) officiated at its opening ceremony, an event commemorated in the university's Redbrick Peel Building and which allowed 'Royal' to be appended to the name of the institute.

At the start of the 20th century, mechanical engineering, chemical works, textiles and construction dominated the industrial scene in Salford. This heavily influenced the choice of subjects offered in the nine departments initially opened. These were Engineering, Electrical Engineering & Applied Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Building, Dyeing, Spinning & Weaving, Domestic, and Art. Some 1,240 students registered for the first session in these departments. There were originally 19 members of staff.

In 1921 the institute was renamed the Royal Technical College, Salford. In 1958 the institution split into two organisations: the remaining Royal Technical College and a breakaway institution, Peel Park Technical College. This changed its name first in 1961 to Salford Technical College, before becoming the Salford College of Technology in 1970, and finally University College Salford in 1992.
